questions.question: What does Psalm 85 ask God to do?
options: Send rain upon the thirsty ground
Establish the king upon his throne
Repay all the nations for their great cruelty
Restore his people and revive them again
questions.answer: Restore his people and revive them again

questions.question: What beautiful image describes God's attributes meeting?
options: Day and night flow together at last into one single, unending, glorious light
The wide open sea and the bright open sky are joined together at the far horizon
The sun and the moon and the stars all bow low before the great throne of the LORD
Steadfast love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss each other
questions.answer: Steadfast love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss each other

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD will give what is good, and the land will yield its increase.
Will you not _____ us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
